entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...What is this place? It's kinda creepy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And a dead end at that. Why's it even exist?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now hold on... Just watch. This is most[n]likely not an ordinary wall.

entries.speaker: Metaverse Navigator
entries.en: A new area has been confirmed in the[n]depths. Updating guidance information.
entries.uk: У глибинах виявлено нову зону.[n]Оновлюю навігаційні дані.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: See!? It's just as I thought!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That wall wouldn't budge when I came[n]here by myself before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But it'd be weird for the deepest part of[n]Mementos to be some normal place like[n]this, wouldn't it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you were thinkin' there's gotta be[n]more?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah! Now that Kamoshida's Palace is[n]gone and people are actually starting to[n]talk about us...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I knew something had to have changed[n]down here!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How deep is it? Should we try going[n]further down?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's not. That's not why we're here today,[n]remember?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've already accomplished our goal.[n]We should head back and I'll explain[n]more once we're home.
